$comment: Read by scripts/lib/content-formatter.js and scripts/syndicate-content.js. maxLength is the platform's post limit; urlLength makes every URL count as that many characters (Mastodon); countGraphemes counts emoji as one character (Bluesky); categories limits a platform to those categories. Which categories syndicate at all lives in publication.config.json. See docs/operations/syndication.md.

instagram.comment: Meta caps accounts at 50 API-published posts per 24h; stay conservative
